generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Last five years achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount.

Satisfactoriy completed at least 50% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 50% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).For Reserved Tenders Satisfactoriy completed at least 25% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 25% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments And Soil excavator such as Hitachi/Jcb
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Karnataka Forest Department for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
A copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
Caste Certificate Compulsory (for reserved category tenders)
Submission of Bid capacity (5 years Turnover) Amount of works contracted by contractors in all departments in the year 2026-27 (indent-wise) and turnover for the last five years

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of High Density Bamboo Plantation at Dharoli recorded forest FS No 41,43 (10 Ha) in Khanapur range khanapur sub division under NBM head

itemList.description: Survey and Demarcation of Planting Areas: Survey and demarcation of plantation boundary lines after clearing the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas width:- Sparse under growth.
Aligning in the planting area along to the contours and marking for pit (without staking)

Excavation of pits with vertically cut edges to make an uniform cube and heaping the excavated soil (1/3rd top soil on the upper side and 2/3rd on the lower side) Ordinary soil of size 0.60x0.60x0.60 = 0.216 cum per pit (400 Pits/Ha)
Procurement or Cost of Raising 8 x12 PB seedlings Including 10% casuality replacement

Refilling of pits, cutting of edge of the pit on the lower side and refilling 75% or 100% of the pit as the case may be with the excavated soil, duly breaking the clods and arranging the remaining soil on the lower slope.

Loading of polythene bagged seedlings into the vehicle at the nursery site and unloading at the site nearest to the planting site including 10% casuality replacement. Seedlings raised in 8"x12" size bags.
Transportation of polythene bagged seedlings in hired truck from the nursery site to planting site. Seedlings raised in 8"x12" size bags. Distance from 21 to 30 km.
Conveyance of polythene bagged seedlings on head load from the dumping site to planting location near each pit. 8"x12" size bagged seedlings. (Distance upto 3 km).
Watering polythene bagged seedlings at planting site by dipping in water, including carrying of water. 8"x12" size bagged seedlings

Planting of P.B. Seedlings after tearing with blade and removing the polythene bags in pits including scooping the soil to required depth, pressing the soil gently around the seedlings after planting. 8"x12" size bagged seedlings.
Purchase of DAP (50 gm per plant)
Application of chemical fertilizer around the plants about 15 cm. away in a furrow duly covering with soil (excluding the cost of fertilizer) in two equal split doses.
First weeding around the plants (pits) to a readius 60 cm
Scraping of grass and other weed growth around the plant (Pits) (Scraping item is allowed only in grass-infested areas) 60 cm. radius around the plant.
Hoeing and soil working with pickaxe around the plant to a depth of 15cm. and to a radius of 50 cm. so as to loosen the soil around the plants (pits only).
FIRE PROTECTION WORK IN PLANTATION: NEW FIRE LINES: Cutting of all existing weed growth to a width of 3 m. heaping, burning and re-burning in younger plantations.
Watering the polythene-bagged seedlings twice a day. 1.4.2026-31.5.2026-61 days
Weeding in the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Purchase of Barbed wire (INncluding GST-18% 12 X14 Guage good quality of G.I. Barbed wire zinc coating thickness of minimum 90 GSM

Preparation of fence posts, duly fashioned conical at the top, debarked and tar coated complete; 2 m length and 38 cm Girth (Wooden post material should be obtained from dead timber material already available in forest areas or by singling out of forked poles of appropriate size and not by cutting live tree).
Transport of fence posts up to 10 km distance including loading and unloading charges using hired vehicle.
Fixing the fence posts after digging pits of 30 cm x 30 cm x 40 cm depth and consolidation, ensuring firm fixture.
Cost of "U" Nails
Unrolling and fixing barbed wire with 'U' nails in four rows, ensuring proper fixture. (excludes cost of wire and 'U' nails).
Docmentation in the form of Bookslets, Succesess stories, Photographs, Adit Reports, Misc rounding off
